published_ranges._enclosure: Heated chamber 80-150C per TDS (test parts printed at 90C chamber)
published_ranges._notes: TDS 'THE K10 PC' rev 03, 14/01/2022 (high-heat PC); settings based on a 0.4mm nozzle. Nozzle 310-350C and bed 140-180C exceed what X1/P1 series printers reach (X1/P1 nozzle max 300C, bed max 100-110C); likely not printable on those. Also 2.85mm (+/-0.03). Density is a range, so filament_density left unset. No drying spec published.
